title.narrative: Programa de Integracin Vial
Road Integration Program

description.narrative: El objetivo del Programa es mejorar la accesibilidad del transporte en zonas rurales de Nicaragua con alta incidencia de pobreza, facilitando la integracin de zonas productivas a reas de consumo y de la poblacin a servicios pblicos y sociales; y contribuyendo a la reduccin de la pobreza. Los objetivos especficos del programa para los tramos rurales intervenidos son: (i) reducir los costos promedio de operacin vehicular (US$vehculo-km); (ii) reducir los tiempos promedio de recorrido (minutos-vehculo por tramo); y (iii) promover y facilitar el uso de la infraestructura vial para el transporte de carga y de pasajeros.

The objective of the Program is to improve transport accessibility in rural zones of Nicaragua with high incidence of poverty, facilitating the integration of productive zones to consumption areas and population to public and social services areas; and contributing to poverty reduction. The specific objectives of the Program for the rural roads intervened are: (i) reduce average vehicle operating costs (US$vehicle-km); (ii) reduce the average travel time (minutes-vehicle per road section); and (iii) promote and facilitate the use of road infrastructure to transport cargo and passengers.
